channel.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest
channel.description: Independent daily summary of public forum activity in the Rootstock Collective, compiled by Anode Research.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-20
item.description: Discussion on four grant threads including the BitChill V2 relaunch, a SwaptoX milestone review, and a resubmitted delegate compensation vote for October 2026.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-19
item.description: Four existing grant threads saw updates: a BitChill Q&A, RPC testing design feedback, the SwaptoX Milestone review, and an endorsement in the application guidelines thread. No new topics.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-18
item.description: Five delegates voted FOR the delegate compensation resubmission, and the SwaptoX Milestone review continued with the timelock still open. No new topics.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-17
item.description: SwaptoX asked whether an on-chain proposal is now required for its Milestone 3, and SEEDGov voted FOR the delegate compensation resubmission. No new topics.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-16
item.description: SwaptoX posted a Milestone 1 swap demonstration for the 2601 Grant SwaptoX Aggregator. No new topics.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-15
item.description: One new post, a courtesy acknowledgement in the 2611 Grant BitChill proposal thread. No new topics.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-13
item.description: Predge narrows Milestone 1 scope to on-chain verifiability, SwaptoX reports Milestone 3 with the DApp live on app.swaptox.com.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-12
item.description: Andromeda Core closes the FES pilot with an inconclusive result and requests no payment.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-11
item.description: Three grantee updates (Predge, 1delta, Geyser) and two more For votes on GRANT 2611 delegate compensation, with no new topics.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-10
item.description: Three delegate votes, all For, on GRANT 2611 (Recognized Delegate Compensation) and no new topics on the forum in this window.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-09
item.description: Two delegate votes, both For, on GRANT 2611 (Recognized Delegate Compensation) and no new topics on the forum in this window.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-08
item.description: One new post: PGov voted For GRANT 2611 Recognized Delegate Compensation for October, 4,000 USDRIF total.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-07
item.description: No new topics; one new post. Tane restated on the Andromeda Core thread that stage payments only trigger after the pilot clears its gate.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-06
item.description: No new topics; one new post. DAOstar_gov asked SwaptoX to document how API incidents are communicated to integrators.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-11-05
item.description: No new proposals; two pre-AMA grants (Predge, RPCDrift) advanced through delegate scrutiny and the Andromeda pilot posted interim metrics ahead of its Nov 11 report.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-10-29
item.description: No new topics, but detailed delegate scrutiny on two grant proposals: Predge 2610 and RPCDrift.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-10-28
item.description: No new topics, but active Q&A on three grant proposals: Predge 2610, RPCDrift, and Kleros Foresight 2609.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-10-27
item.description: Carl posted a new grant proposal, RPCDrift, an RPC compatibility and regression testing toolkit. Grant 2610 (Predge) drew supportive replies from Seviramar and IBUKI.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-10-26
item.description: No new topics or posts on the Rootstock Collective forum in this window.

item.title: Rootstock Collective governance digest: 2026-10-23
